title: Human-In-The-Loop Workflow
review_focus: Make the review and revision loop feel central rather than decorative
Show where humans add value without overcomplicating the system
Preserve clear sequencing across drafting, tool use, review, and revision
Keep it useful to less technical stakeholders
generation_prompt: Use the local Excalidraw skill in `{repo_root}/SKILL.md` and the references directory as your methodology. Create a comprehensive Excalidraw diagram showing a human-in-the-loop workflow for AI-assisted content generation. Show how a request moves through orchestration, tool use, draft generation, review checkpoints, and revision before a final deliverable is accepted. This should feel grounded in software and AI systems, but be understandable to less technical stakeholders. Include one small evidence artifact such as a compact draft excerpt or review checklist snippet. Avoid a generic swimlane made of uniform cards. Save the final diagram exactly to `{diagram_path}`. Run the render-and-validate loop with the local renderer until the result feels presentation-ready. In your final response, briefly explain the diagram and confirm the saved path.
